description: Drone Nadir-View Annotated Images of Vehicles Detection Dataset for India With Heading-Angle Oriented Bounding Box (DRASHTI-HaOBB) is a data set described in the paper "Drone Nadir-View Annotated Images of Vehicles Detection Dataset for India With Heading-Angle Oriented Bounding Box (DRASHTI-HaOBB)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Yagnik M. Bhavsar, Mazad S. Zaveri, Mehul S. Raval and colleagues. Road accidents remain one of the leading causes of fatalities and injuries worldwide. In developing and densely populated countries such as India, the number of vehicles has increased exponentially; however, road infrastructure has not kept pace, leading to more traffic problems and road accidents. Hence, an effective road traffic monitoring (RTM) system is used for studying traffic problems and mitigating the risk of road accidents. Coverage: roads in India captured by drone. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support vehicle detection and road traffic monitoring. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
